nodes.title: Natural Sciences and Technology
nodes.description: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 1

nodes.title: Life and Living: Photosynthesis
nodes.description: Describe photosynthesis as the process by which plants make food using sunlight, water and carbon dioxide. Write and interpret the word equation for photosynthesis. Explain the role of chlorophyll.

nodes.title: Life and Living: Nutrients in Food
nodes.description: Identify the main nutrients in food: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals and water. Describe the role of each nutrient in the body.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Particles in Solids, Liquids and Gases
nodes.description: Use the particle model to explain the properties of solids, liquids and gases. Describe particle arrangement, movement and spacing in each state.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Electric Circuits
nodes.description: Investigate and build simple series and parallel circuits. Describe the role of components: battery, bulb, switch and wire. Draw circuit diagrams using standard symbols.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 2

nodes.title: Life and Living: Nutrition and Balanced Diets
nodes.description: Describe what constitutes a balanced diet. Explain the consequences of nutritional deficiencies and excesses. Analyse food labels to assess nutritional content.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Mixtures
nodes.description: Describe and classify mixtures as heterogeneous or homogeneous. Investigate methods of separating mixtures: filtering, sieving, evaporation and magnetic separation.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Solutions and Dissolving
nodes.description: Describe solutions as homogeneous mixtures of a solute dissolved in a solvent. Investigate factors that affect dissolving: temperature, particle size and stirring.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Conductors and Insulators
nodes.description: Classify materials as electrical conductors or insulators through investigation. Describe the uses of conductors and insulators in electrical devices.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: The Solar System
nodes.description: Describe the structure of the solar system. Name and order the planets from the Sun. Describe the relative sizes and distances of planets.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 3

nodes.title: Life and Living: Ecosystems and Food Webs
nodes.description: Describe the components of an ecosystem: biotic and abiotic factors. Construct and interpret food webs. Explain how changes in one species affect the whole food web.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Water Pollution and Wetlands
nodes.description: Describe causes and effects of water pollution. Explain the importance of wetlands as natural water filters. Identify ways to prevent and reduce water pollution.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Purifying Water
nodes.description: Describe the steps in purifying water: sedimentation, filtration, chlorination. Design and build a simple water filter. Evaluate the effectiveness of the filter.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Systems to Solve Problems
nodes.description: Investigate systems that use electrical energy to solve problems. Design and make a system that uses a switch to control an output device.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Earth's Rotation and Revolution
nodes.description: Differentiate between Earth's rotation and revolution. Explain how the tilt of Earth's axis causes seasons. Describe the length of day and night at different times of year.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 4

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Mains Electricity and Fossil Fuels
nodes.description: Describe how mains electricity is generated using fossil fuels. Explain the environmental impact of burning fossil fuels. Identify renewable energy alternatives.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Moon's Movements
nodes.description: Describe the Moon's orbit around Earth. Explain the phases of the Moon and their causes. Describe how the Moon's gravity causes tides.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Telescopes
nodes.description: Describe how telescopes extend our ability to observe space. Compare optical and radio telescopes. Describe significant telescopes and their discoveries.

nodes.title: Technology: Moon and Mars Rovers
nodes.description: Describe the design and purpose of space rovers. Investigate how rovers are controlled remotely. Design a simple rover system that can perform a task.

nodes.title: Revision and Consolidation
nodes.description: Revision and consolidation of all Grade 6 Natural Sciences and Technology content.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — End-of-year Test.
